# Chiplet_Reconfigurable_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-23

## Definition
A chiplet-based interconnect topology whose logical links and routing behavior can be reconfigured via software after assembly. It allows TCC architectures to optimize inter-chiplet bandwidth and latency dynamically for changing workloads.
